newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU says unwrapped gifts in food packets dangerous.
newsitem.headline: EU says unwrapped gifts in food packets dangerous.

text.p: The European Commissioner for Consumer Affairs Emma Bonino has urged EU governments to make sure that food manufacturers wrap up gifts contained in packets of food to prevent people swallowing them by accident.

She was speaking after a meeting of the EU's emergencies committee on general product safety, which said unwrapped and non-edible gifts -- an increasingly popular form of marketing -- posed a "serious and immediate risk to health."
Her appeal applied to "packets of potato crisps and other products" which contain non-edible gifts, a Commission spokesman said.
"We all have the necessary instruments," Bonino said. "What we now need is putting them to work."
The Commission urged EU governments to identify the products concerned, restrict their placing on the market and report back by the middle of September.
